chunks: THE DECREE of GOD will surely come; so do not try to hasten it: Too glorious and high is He for what they associate with Him.

key_terms.أَمْرَ اللَّهِ: The decree or command of God

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Amr Allah' refer to in the context of hastening divine decree?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the certainty of divine resurrection, urging believers to remain patient rather than impatiently awaiting the Hour. It reinforces the concept of Tawhid by contrasting the inevitable truth of God's command with the falsehood of polytheistic associations, a theme central to the Surah's discourse on monotheism.
